usageNotes: Call this before configuring an ACME account or DNS/HTTP challenge plugin to discover which challenge types (e.g. 'dns', 'standalone') are available on the cluster and what parameters each type requires. No authentication privilege beyond a valid user session is needed — API tokens are accepted. The response schema object per entry describes the fields required to configure that challenge type, so parse it before calling any ACME plugin create/update endpoint.

examples.summary: List all supported ACME challenge types and their configuration schemas

tips: The 'schema' field in each returned object is a JSON Schema describing the parameters needed to configure that challenge type — use it to validate plugin configuration before submission.
The 'id' field is what you pass as the 'type' or 'api' parameter in ACME plugin creation calls; 'name' is display-only.
This endpoint requires no special privilege and is safe to call at any time — use it for feature detection when building tooling that targets multiple PVE versions.
